scenarios.normal: Pass through to the disposable server.
scenarios.delayed-old-query: Hold an old query until a new query is served, then delay 750 ms and prefix only old row titles with Obsolete old query; acknowledge distinct response payloads in order.
scenarios.rate-limit-120: Search answers HTTP 429 and Retry-After 120; each injection is counted.
scenarios.stale-answer: Search passes through, then carries stale=true and original age 7200 seconds.
scenarios.offline: Close app connections while control and independent server assertions remain available.
scenarios.lost-add-receipt: Deliver one add to the server, then close the response connection.
scenarios.scan-arrival: Install the generated tagged arrival file, run startScan and await scan/fulfilment.
scenarios.remove-before-add: Hold an add until cancellation is observed, bounded to 2 seconds.
scenarios.identity-replacement: Restore the documented Testing checkpoint, changing the real server instanceId.
scenarios.future-metadata: Expose a future kind/status and a missing-MBID row, both unwishable.
scenarios.held-detail: Hold artist/album detail after recording held=true until POST /control/release-detail; acknowledge released=true, with a 90-second safety expiry.
scenarios.held-wishlist: Hold Wishlist reads after recording held=true until POST /control/release-read; acknowledge released=true, with a 90-second safety expiry.
